title: A Kingdom of Quartz's BOMHAT Launches New Manga Series
content: Kodansha 's Comic Days platform announced on Wednesday that BOMHAT will launch a new series titled Coquette on the platform on Thursday at noon (Wednesday at 11:00 p.m. EDT). The series follows struggling ballerina Cosette, who can't reach the level of a soloist despite devoting her life to training.
author: ANN

title: Acclaimed Shonen Anime Confirms Major Return in July
content: Shonen is the most popular demographic in the anime and manga industry, famous for all kinds of exciting stories. Fantasies, adventure, sports, and several different kinds of these series are often loved among fans for their unique storytelling.
author: ComicBook

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Gets Disappointing Streaming Update
content: It’s been almost a year since the first installment of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle trilogy was released, but the anime has yet to reveal more updates on the upcoming two films.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Returns With a Brand New Release Ahead of Season 4
content: After an exciting run in Winter this year, Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 reached its conclusion with a major cliffhanger, leaving several questions unanswered. The story continues after the intense Shibuya Incident Arc, following the aftermath of the major battle that took place during Halloween.
author: ComicBook

title: Omamori Himari Manga Gets Special 1-Shot for 20th Anniversary
content: The July issue of Kadokawa 's Monthly Dragon Age magazine published Milan Matra 's special 24-page one-shot of his Omamori Himari manga on Tuesday. The one-shot commemorates the manga's 20th anniversary. Matra's Omamori Himari manga launched in Monthly Dragon Age in 2006, and it ended in September 2013.
author: ANN

title: Hiroshi Shimomoto's Delinquent Gacha Manga Enters Last Arc
content: Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story: Jikkai High, with a low academic score of just nine, is a bottom-tier school where delinquents from all over the country gather, with new transfer students arriving almost every week.
author: ANN

title: 2026 Is the Year of Female Anime Characters (& These 5 Prove It)
content: 2026 is reaching its halfway point, meaning many of the new and returning anime released this year have already come to an end. As a result, it is the perfect time to reflect on what the year has produced so far.
author: ComicBook

title: Stupid Never Dies Action Game Debuts in Fall
content: Osaka-based game development studio GPTrack50 revealed in a new trailer on Wednesday its Stupid Never Dies action game will launch for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam in fall 2026. The company describes the game: Julia has frozen to death. Monsters roam the streets. How did the world end up like this…?
author: ANN

title: Over Requiemz Otome Game's Trailer Previews Opening Song
content: Aksys Games began streaming a new trailer for Idea Factory and Kogado Studio's OVER REQUIEMZ , an otome game based on The Wizard of Oz , on Tuesday. The trailer previews the game's opening theme song "Muted Expectations" by Hisano.
author: ANN
